descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 NTT DATA Romania is looking for passionate Engineers for designing and improving security solutions and to offer architecture consultancy within various projects and activities.
You must have the drive to integrate high-quality software components, hardware components, security, database, systems, and business continuity planning that will run in a complex technical environment. The deliverables will be tailored based on customers and user needs, test cases and test processes have to be defined and implemented. You will be a member of the Cybersecurity Competence Center, where your skills and contributions to security systems delivery will be very visible. The team is international so you will use English both written and orally, German knowledge would be an advantage.
 What You'll Be Doing
Work with Linux, Public and Private Clouds (Azure, GCP), scripting, Elastic stack, KeyCloak, SOAR, Ansible, Docker, Grafana and others
Work primarily with systems and solutions designs in relation to various aspects of information security technologies, processes, and requirements
Research, plan and design robust security architectures for various IT infrastructures based on internationally recognized standards and best security practices
Innovative service design and development, driven by business strategy and goals
Engineering innovative systems which meet goals, requirements, SLA’s, and other quality attributes
Design systems for operational efficiency, automation, and ease of operation considering optimal cost and metering of service consumption
Assistance of technical experts within operational teams
Work closely with Project Managers and project members for delivering security into projects
Contribute to security programs for the NTTDATA clients and businesses
On Call and On Duty responsibilities 
 What You'll Bring Along
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a similar role
Master’s or bachelor’s degree in related fields, preferably Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics areas, with an overall minimum of 2 years of relevant experience
Proven track record of building, securing, and automating enterprise-scale infrastructure and systems
In-depth knowledge of processes, research, and performance analysis capabilities
Ansible + AWX (strong requirement)
IAM knowledge is a big plus (Organizations, Realms, Roles, etc.). Any IAM tools would do, KeyCloak would be highly appreciated.
Docker containers (Kubernetes is a plus)
Linux (pro-efficient)
Elastic components are a plus: Filebeat, Logstash
Azure: EventHub
Network & VPN, build and debugging
Grafana & Prometheus are a plus
Experience with parsers it’s a plus
In-depth technical knowledge within information security areas is an advantage: SIEM tools and solutions, Incident Response tools and solutions, Vulnerability Management tools and procedures, SOAR and EDR solutions, Security Threat Intelligence services
CISSP, CEH, SANS, or similar certifications represent a big plus
Highly effective written and oral communication skills, excellent interpersonal skills, and experience dealing effectively with people having different background
Fluency in Business English is required, German is an advantage
Customer-oriented behavior
Fast learner - research capabilities for obtaining required information
